_comment: Proposed meaningful strategic regions for the ~460-province 'full Europe' grand theater (Vic3/HOI4-style macro zones). UK split into 5 regions. Replace/seed strategic_regions.json during merge. ~20-30 provinces per region at full Europe density.

regions.name: Ireland
regions.notes: Republic + Northern Ireland; provinces stay separate.

regions.name: Low Countries
regions.notes: Netherlands, Belgium, Luxembourg. Dense, high infra, chokepoints.

regions.name: Western Germany
regions.notes: Rhineland, Ruhr, Saar. Industrial heartland + French border.

regions.name: Scandinavia
regions.notes: Norway (fjords), Sweden, Denmark. Iron ore, northern flank.

regions.name: Baltic Littoral
regions.notes: Baltic states, East Prussia, Polish coast, Danish Straits.

regions.name: Poland & Silesia
regions.notes: Core Poland, Silesia, Krakow. Eastern Front gateway.

regions.name: Alpine & North Italy
regions.notes: Switzerland, Austrian Alps, Po valley, Venice.

regions.name: Western Mediterranean
regions.notes: Corsica, Sardinia, Balearics; Malta solo province.

regions.name: Central Russia Edge
regions.notes: East of Leningrad/Moscow approaches for depth.

regions.name: Atlantic Approaches
regions.notes: Faroes, Iceland, Bay of Biscay, convoy routes.
